description: Canonical eval registry (HAR-97 CANONICAL EVAL STRATEGY, section 12): E1-E22 evals plus the operational diagnostics M1-M5, each with the surfaces and the dimensions it protects (the completeness matrix, contracts/evals/completeness_matrix.json, is checked against them). status: implemented = grader or metric code and gold on main; partial = a proxy, a unit-tested mechanism or a computable-but-unreported metric; planned = nothing on main, owned by a Linear issue. contract_status pending = the section 12 definitions (inputs, required trace fields, pass/warn/fail/unknown, failure modes, gold dataset) are written at the construction gate before implementation; implemented evals carry theirs in contracts/evals/eval_catalog.json and the rubrics. knowledge_mutation_allowed is true only for the behavior-changing and learning evals (HAR-97 section 4 and 6); validation, execution, safety and operational entries never are.

families.name: Source / evidence fidelity
families.invariant: An inference must never silently become a source fact.

families.name: Entity / account resolution
families.invariant: Uncertain identity must not silently mutate the wrong account.

families.name: Graph / world mutation
families.invariant: One evidence change must alter only causally dependent world state (mutation locality).

families.name: State / transition interpretation
families.invariant: State is evidence-backed interpretation, not a label invented to justify an action.

families.name: Knowledge influence attribution
families.invariant: Retrieval is not influence: retrieved, applicable, used and changed-the-decision are traced separately.

families.name: Decision construction
families.invariant: There may be several defensible GTM decisions; no universal binary answer is forced.

families.name: Decision ranking / recommendation
families.invariant: Deterministic correct-decision grading is used only where strong ground truth exists.

families.name: Human interaction interpretation
families.invariant: Every approval, edit, rejection, selection, ignore or delay is an observation, not automatic truth.

families.name: Edit / override propagation
families.invariant: An edit invalidates dependent work, recomputes the current episode and preserves unrelated state.

families.name: Action / output generation
families.invariant: Decision quality and artifact quality are graded separately.

families.name: Tool use / permissions / writes
families.invariant: No single exact tool trajectory is enforced when several are valid.

families.name: Knowledge mutation
families.invariant: One weak signal cannot silently create universal policy; mutations are trace-justified, scoped, versioned and reversible.

families.name: Knowledge to future-behavior realization
families.invariant: Applicable learned knowledge improves behavior (B over A); irrelevant knowledge changes nothing (C equals A).

families.name: Continual knowledge revision
families.invariant: Knowledge is versioned evidence, never learned forever.

families.invariant: Trace completeness: every consequential episode reconstructs backward to its causes and forward to its consequences.

families.name: Stochastic reliability
